Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Proposed MAP & evaluation timeline — EB meeting request

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — great alignment on the primary use cases and success metrics. I put together a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and a short evaluation checklist to make the EB/conclusion process as straightforward as possible. Attached: MAP_STLR_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet).

High level asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the executive sponsor you'd like to lead EB on your side (name + role)?
- We propose an EB (exec briefing) to review the MAP, run through the evaluation cadence, and confirm the close timeline. Suggested target close date: 2027-06-15.
- If procurement needs to be included at this stage, please loop them in.

Proposed EB time windows (your timezone):
- Tue 2027-06-08: 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00
- Wed 2027-06-09: 11:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00

If those don't work, tell me three times that do and we’ll adapt.

Next steps I can own once I have your sponsor and preferred slot: share an updated MAP with deliverables and a short pre-read for the execs.

Attachment: MAP_STLR_v1.xlsx (excel)

Best,
Irene

Liam — jumping in to align on the MAP and logistics. Thanks for confirming Elena as the sponsor. Adding a short evaluation plan and a tightened MAP with milestones. Attached: MAP_STLR_v1.1.xlsx and EvalChecklist_Stellar.pdf.

Key pieces we updated:
- MAP milestones: pre-EB smoke test (48h window), canary run, configuration freeze, and target go-live readiness checklist.
- Evaluation plan maps the success criteria you listed to concrete test artifacts (latency, throughput, hallucination checks, sample prompt sets).
- Proposed final close target: 2027-06-15. To make that runway work we need: sponsor confirmation (received), EB by 2027-06-09, and procurement terms agreed by 2027-06-12.

EB slots we can hold (PT):
- 2027-06-09 11:00–12:00 (preferred — Elena indicated okay)
- 2027-06-10 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm the 6/9 11:00 slot and confirm who from procurement will own commercial sign-off? If we get confirmation by 2027-06-04 EOD, we’ll lock resources and circulate the exec pre-read + short demo plan.

Attachments: MAP_STLR_v1.1.xlsx, EvalChecklist_Stellar.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0208

Marissa / Irene — procurement here. Quick update from our side: we can provision a slot on 2027-06-09 but will need the following before we sign off on commercial timelines:

1) SOC2 Type II report and a short summary of production/data retention terms for the eval environment.
2) Confirmation of pricing tiers for Dedicated vs Hosted for the pilot (line-item export).
3) A draft SOW or purchase order template to review redlines.

We reviewed the MAP and evaluation checklist — those look reasonable, thank you. Please send the SOC2 PDF and the pricing export to procurement@stellarapps.com and upload contractual artifacts to the shared drive.

Proposed next steps:
- Attach the SOC2 and pricing export to this thread (or provide a Drive link) by EOD 2027-06-04 so we can complete legal review by 2027-06-12.
- We will tentatively hold 2027-06-09 11:00–12:00 for the EB; please confirm the attendee list (Elena Park + 2 execs from our side).
